notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.2 - Autosave's Here!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/a881187431fd02ba9242aae6e20f13a4a4136305.png"]


Patch Notes


☀️ Fixes & Improvements Based on Community Feedback


Bugfixes:
☀️ Fixed an issue where the game would consume excessive memory and freeze when paused and left running for an extended period.

☀️ Fixed a bug where quickly placing a launchpad while moving the mouse could cause the placement to fail while still subtracting tech points and credits. This could lead to softlocks and occurred more frequently on lower-FPS PCs and Steam Deck.

☀️ Sector 03.1: Fixed ceramic not displaying a recipe in the wiki when playing this sector before Sector 04.

☀️ Fixed audio clips cutting off prematurely when fast-forwarding game speed.

☀️ Fixed custom key rebinds only initializing after opening the rebinding screen instead of loading automatically.

Fixed the rebind button not reverting to its default label when starting a different rebind process, which effectively canceled the current one.

☀️ Added a stick deadzone to prevent drifting on connected gamepads, which caused the asteroid to keep rotating.

☀️ Fixed the "Edge Rotation Enabled" setting reverting to its default value after restarting the game.
Achievements:
☀️ Added a progress bar for most achievements — either counting down (e.g., for the Space Falcon challenge) or counting up.

☀️ Disabled "Achievement Missed" notifications if the achievement has already been unlocked.

Added a “missed” visual state (semi-transparent) to achievement badges.

☀️ Sector 05: Improved consistency of Hard Melting remaining ice area calculation. (Note: Ice can still spawn under craters, preventing the achievement from triggering — check the progress bar to confirm.)
Other Improvements:
☀️ Implemented autosave at fixed intervals: the game now saves automatically when switching scenes if 3 minutes have passed, and after 6 minutes if staying in the same scene. This can be disabled in the settings menu.

☀️ Added descriptions to most resource and building wiki entries.

☀️ Improved performance when drawing very long rover paths.

☀️ When syncing game data with Steam Cloud, the game no longer considers it a first launch on a new PC (which would play the prologue cutscene and restart Level 01) if save data already exists.

☀️ Sector 01: Stats screen and score tooltip are now accessible before completing the sector.

Sector 01: The Intro cutscene no longer plays every time  when restarting the sector after completing it once.

Sector 05: Removed inaccessible small craters from plateaus to avoid confusion.

☀️ Rover no longer moves while the game is paused.

☀️ Added a game resolution setting to the cutscene skip menu.

☀️ When a Strangelet is excavated (last excavation quest fulfilled), it now disappears from the asteroid and the excavation hub performing the excavation is destroyed, making it clear that the hub is no longer active.

Pause the cutscene playback while the cutscene skip menu is open.

Added social buttons to the credits screen for kurzgesagt’s Bluesky and TikTok profiles.





The best place to give feedback is our Discord server. There, we are running a Smart Ticketing System: Leave feedback, vote up change requests and bug reports from other users, and help us to prioritize tasks in the further development of Star Birds. 



 🙏Thank you so much everyone for the overwhelming response, all your feedback, comments and bug reports! This helps us a lot to prioritize and identify issues with the game. We're trying to address the most critical issues as soon as we can. Please be patient though, since we're a small team and might take a while to address specific issues you're experiencing!🙏

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.1.1 - For Tutorial Beginners & Highscore Hunters
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/6f93745bc524153c6b952602c302f9065290c214.png"]


Patch Notes


☀️ Fixes & Improvements Based on Community Feedback



Bugfixes:

☀️ Sector 01: Fixed last tutorial step not triggering (outro dialogue not starting) when connecting the refiner to a launch pad before connecting it to a water extractor

☀️ Sector 03: Acid recipe now unlocks by default at the start of Level 03 to prevent module quests from stopping at station level 13 when level 14 is required for the Logistics achievement.

☀️ Sector 05.1: Fixed High Score 05.1 condition incorrectly rewarding the Star Bird 05.1 achievement, which made High Score 05.1 unobtainable.

☀️ Enter and Discover asteroid tooltips no longer render in front of the in-game menu, dialogues, or other UI elements.

☀️ Hovering over buildings is no longer detected when the building is obscured by UI (e.g. bug reporting or in-game menu screens).

☀️ Fixed music track skipping when alt + tabbing out of game while Run In Background is disabled.

☀️ Fixed an issue where deleting a Receiver sometimes caused two interplanetary connection lines to be drawn on top of each other, making it seem like one was missing.

Flying coin particles no longer freeze when opening the in-game menu.



Improvements:

☀️ Sector 04: Added an additional trigger to unblock ice extractor research. Previously, it only became available after starting the first Strangelet excavation quest. It now also becomes researchable when starting any quest that requests water, methane or acid.

Sector 04: The last excavation quest now grants +1 Strangelet, and there is a separate goal quest that rewards victory for obtaining 1 Strangelet.

☀️ Sector 07: Hid the recipe requiring conductor & feather to make thread so players focus on the simpler feather-in-refiner recipe instead.

Added tooltip to Edge Rotation Enabled setting in controls tab to make it clearer what it does: disabling the auto rotation of an asteroid while drawing paths or placing buildings (tooltip only in English and German for now).

☀️ Fixed some typos in German translation.

Version number now displays with a "v" prefix instead of "Version."

Improved tooltip positioning in the in-game menu.

Removed debug frame rates from the target frame rate dropdown.

Added a small delay before the loading screen disappears when starting a game from the menu to prevent the menu flashing for a frame before the game begins.





The best place to give feedback is our Discord server. There, we are running a Smart Ticketing System: Leave feedback, vote up change requests and bug reports from other users, and help us to prioritize tasks in the further development of Star Birds. 



 🙏Thank you so much everyone for the overwhelming response, all your feedback, comments and bug reports! This helps us a lot to prioritize and identify issues with the game. We're trying to address the most critical issues as soon as we can. Please be patient though, since we're a small team and might take a while to address specific issues you're experiencing!🙏

notes.title: Star Birds: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
The Star Birds Early Access Version is out now. Play Star Birds today.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/bd2a686ddb275b6d0a95bab04381db6da4481d2c.png"]


Star Birds takes flight into Early Access today!

In the Early Access version, you can dive right into 7 full Story Levels, plus additional randomized Expedition Levels for endless replayability. This is just the beginning—regular content updates will be landing until the full release, so there’s plenty more to come. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/2f8b13c5ee8a4ad56a060ffd4c3fea34522663b9.png"]


What’s inside Early Access?
In this Early Access version, you’ll set out into a brand-new star system where things get frosty. 

🥶 The Bird Crew will encounter icy plains rich in methane and water to extract, and rugged plateaus that demand clever ramp-building to traverse. 

⚡ To power up your expanding settlement, electricity comes into play for the first time, adding a new layer of resource management and strategy. 

🚀 Alongside these new mechanics, the campaign story continues: the Bird Crew’s hunt for the mysterious Strangelet carries on, with 7 story missions to experience in this phase of the game.

🏆 Look forward to building upgrades, cool achievements, and challenge yourself with the Star Score!

Why Early Access?
For you as players, Early Access means you don’t have to wait—you can start playing Star Birds today at a special early bird price and help shape the game’s development with your feedback. For us as an indie team, Early Access gives us the chance to keep the project sustainable while staying true to our studio philosophy: learning, iterating, and building the best version of the game together with our community.

Early Access lets us refine the game with your help. During the Early Access phase we can gather your player feedback early on and make sure Star Birds grows in the right direction. This is especially important since Star Birds has lots of depth, systems, and balancing.

The current Early Access version is already a very stable and smoothly playable experience. We're looking forward to our community playing the game, giving us feedback here in the Community Hub, on Discord or in-game.

notes.title: Evasive Maneuver: EA Release moved to September 10th
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/d360c661324d94ed3674827341cd233e0fc6632f.png"]
Star Birds Early Access launches September 10th 🚀🐦
The flock is almost ready for takeoff! After months of building, tweaking, polishing, and planning, we’re thrilled to say that Star Birds will launch into Early Access very soon.
To make sure the journey starts smoothly, we’re adjusting our flight plan just a little: instead of September 4th, the launch will now be on September 10th, 2025.


Why the change?
Last week at Gamescom we had an intense but wonderful time with there was a HUGE surprise announement: Team Cherry announced the release date for the long-awaited Silksong, and we don’t want to collide beak-on with such a massive hype-supernova. Both games deserve their moment to shine and we wish Team Cherry an amzing success!
 
And honestly, we’re super excited to play Silksong ourselves, too! 🎮✨


These past weeks have been and are still incredibly exciting (and a little hectic) for our team, as we’re juggling lots of things behind the scenes and quickly reworking our release plans. Your feedback and suggestions really helped us make this call, so thank you for your passion, patience, and support - it means the world to us. 💜

We can’t wait to finally share the Early Access version of Star Birds with you on September 10th!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Star Birds will be available in Early Access. Playable for everyone on Sept 10th, 2025.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/296141a27ffa37a4dc99bac23c928b1088e63926.png"]

We’re thrilled to officially announce it: Star Birds will launch in Early Access on September [strike]4[/strike] 10, 2025! [strike]
[/strike]* We've moved the release date to the 10th of September because of Silksong - read more here.

Mark your calendars – in just a few weeks you’ll be able to take off into the colorful, chaotic universe of Star Birds and see where the mission will take you.


Thank You for Shaping Star Birds
Back in June, we released the Star Birds demo – and the response from all of you was incredible.
Your feedback has been invaluable in making the Early Access version the best it can be. You reported bugs, you shared your ideas for what you’d love to see in the game, and you helped us refine both the small details and the bigger gameplay features.


From the whole team: thank you for being such an active and constructive part of this journey.


FAQ – Everything You’re Asking About Early Access


1. Can I Play on My Mac / My Phone / My Console / My Quantum Computer? 💻

Early Access will launch on PC in all the languages already available in the demo. Other platforms are not off the table, but as a small indie team we need to stay focused and work step-by-step to deliver the highest quality possible. We’ll explore other platforms after the full release.



2. Will Star Birds Become More Complex? 🤓 

Compared to the demo, Early Access goes beyond the initial tutorial levels and steps up the complexity. At launch, you’ll be able to play more levels, build more and complex buildings, energy networks and explore many more asteroids. The Early Access release version also adds a second Star System with a bunch of new levels and even more cutscenes. In the new star system things get cold and frosty, so your birds will have to buckle up!



3. Will Star Birds Cost Under 10 Euros / Over 40 Dollars / More Than Lying in the Grass and Gazing at the Starry Sky? 💰

We don’t have a final price to share yet. We know this is an important factor for many of you, and we’re working to find the right sweet spot – making Star Birds as accessible as possible for players while ensuring an appropriate value proposition. We’ll share more as soon as we have something concrete.



4. Can I Play Before September [strike]4[/strike] 10? 😍

Yes! (Wait ... WHAT?! 🤯) If you’re at gamescom this week, we have a fresh new build of the Early Access version ready for you to try out. Stop by the Indie Arena Booth Hall 10.2 at Booth 48, say hi, play Star Birds and give our gacha machine a spin – we’d love to meet you, plus we have lots of goodies to win!



5. Will Steve, the Voice of kurzgesagt Be in the Game?🔊

The question that has kept you all awake ... All clear, everybody! You can breathe easy. We’ve asked Steve to voice text some lines for Star Birds, so you can look forward to hearing the kurzgesagt narrator in the game for certain moments and selected scenes. 



It’s been amazing to see such a constructive, helpful, friendly, and open community forming around Star Birds. Working at lightspeed on the Early Access version is twice as fun when we know we’re building it for such an awesome group of players. Here’s to the countdown for [strike]September 4[/strike] September 10 – and to all the adventures ahead! ✨

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.0.27e - Preventing Softlocks
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053649/4ab5731265c525f84368c5239bd65af361993a42.png"]


Patch Notes


Bugfixes

prevent level 01 soft lock: until the player places their first extractor on the correct resource area (iron), they receive the credits back - this should prevent running out of credits in level 01

prevent level 01 soft lock: until the player placed their second launch pad in level 01 (after the instruction is given), the credits are reset to 100 whenever it drops below 100

prevent level 01 soft lock: added more restrictions preventing the player from completing the water / titanium goal quest in level 1 before the rover mechanic was introduced: their credits are set to 15 instead of 25 (meaning 3 nuggets are required to afford the next extractor), building recall functionality is disabled and extractors in building inventory are cleared

prevent level 02 soft lock: no new excavation quest from Ruth was starting after saving and loading a game in sector 02 and completing the currently active excavation quest

fixed entering the wrong asteroid or showing a blank screen instead of the asteroid when selecting a different one or deselecting the current asteroid while the entering transition is happening

privacy buttons to access analytics privacy consent screen is now visible in Settings > Other

interplanetary connection no longer works with right click (could cause connection drawing getting stuck)

Other

implemented resolution dropdown in graphics settings. Should only allow resolutions with aspect ratio of 16:9 or lower (so no wide screen) - on wide screen, it should set itself to the highest allowed resolution

added labels above Toukana & kurzgesagt in credits screen

Disclaimer:

The Star Birds demo doesn't currently support wide screen monitors - instead, the game will be displayed in 16:9 with black borders on the sides. This is a workaround for now and we fully intend to provide proper wide screen support for the release version!

Star Birds also doesn't have official Steam Deck and Controller support yet. We plan to add both in the future!





The best place to give feedback is our Discord server. There, we are running a Smart Ticketing System: Leave feedback, vote up change requests and bug reports from other users, and help us to prioritize tasks in the further development of Star Birds. 


🙏Thank you so much everyone for the overwhelming response, all your feedback, comments and bug reports! This helps us a lot to prioritize and identify issues with the game.
